newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady, mill demand low.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady, mill demand low.

text.p: Indian cotton prices held steady on Wednesday in a narrow price band amidst low mill demand but on reports of some export deals, dealers said.
"The Cotton Corporation of India has struck a deal for the export of 45-50,000 bales of cotton," one broker said.
"This in turn may trigger fresh buying by the Cotton Corporation of India at the producing centres," he added.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 865/900 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned was quiet at 1,510/1,640. Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) remained steady at 18,000/19,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
